heading_en: Special Provisions for the Portion of Specified Items Not Included in Adjustment Items
summary_ja: 第百五十六条の三の規定を、読替えのうえマーケット・リスク相当額の算出に準用する。
summary_en: Applies Article 156-3 mutatis mutandis, with replaced terms, to the calculation of the market risk equivalent amount.
paragraphs: The provisions of Article 156-3 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the market risk equivalent amount is calculated. In this case, the phrase "an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall, notwithstanding the provisions of Article 129 through the preceding Article" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall, notwithstanding the provisions of Chapter 6, Section 1 through Section 7"; the phrase "the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the exposure relating to" shall be deemed to be replaced with "the market risk equivalent amount of"; the phrase "the amount of that exposure (meaning EAD)" shall be deemed to be replaced with "the amount of that portion"; and the phrase "250%" shall be deemed to be replaced with "20%."

sections_en.第八節: Special Provisions for the Portion of Specified Items Not Included in Adjustment Items
